description: Use this when the user asks about one real liquidity pool, such as "volume and fee APR for WETH and USDC on Ethereum" or "is this pool APR a spike?". Pass pool_id (a DefiLlama UUID), or chain plus token_a and token_b, for example chain "ethereum", token_a "WETH", token_b "USDC". Do not try pool_address first: the open index has no pool contract addresses, so it always returns needs_tokens. Returns 1-day and 7-day volume and fee APR, TVL, an APR flag with a reason, a risk checklist with warnings, price trend, token risk flags when a public source covers them, and an informational position-type label. Symbols for one token pair with several fee tiers or exchanges return the highest-TVL pool, with the others in other_tiers. Symbols that match different tokens return status ambiguous. The optional range fields (price_lower, price_upper, price_now, holding_days, capital_usd, gas_usd, exit_cost_usd) add the same fee-versus-impermanent-loss estimate as estimate_lp, at this pool's fee APR. For a pure what-if with no pool, use estimate_lp.

inputSchema.description: Send pool_id alone, or chain plus token_a and token_b, for example {"chain": "ethereum", "token_a": "WETH", "token_b": "USDC"}. pool_address alone always returns needs_tokens.

capital_usd.description: Position size, so gas and exit cost can be compared with fees. Not stored as a record of who asked

chain.description: Chain name or short alias, used with token_a and token_b: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, solana, zksync, linea, gnosis, scroll, mantle, celo, sonic, or sui. Aliases such as eth, arb, op, bnb, matic, avax, and sol also work

exit_cost_usd.description: Other exit cost, such as a withdrawal fee, in the same currency as capital_usd

gas_usd.description: Gas you expect to pay to enter and exit, in the same currency as capital_usd

holding_days.description: Holding window for the fee-versus-IL estimate. Requires price_lower, price_upper, and price_now

pool_address.description: Pool contract address. The open yields index has no pool contract addresses, so this always returns needs_tokens. Prefer pool_id, or chain with token_a and token_b

pool_id.description: DefiLlama pool id, a UUID such as "b99bcdf5-1350-4269-981e-0e9b5cccb007", from find_active_pools or other_tiers. Send it alone

price_lower.description: Lower price of the range, in quote per base

price_now.description: Current price in the same units as the range

price_upper.description: Upper price of the range, in quote per base

token_a.description: First token symbol or contract address, such as "WETH" or "0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2". Needs chain and token_b

token_b.description: Second token symbol or contract address, such as "USDC"

name: check_pool

active_range.description: The open index does not publish the current tick band

apr_flag.description: real: steady trading. spike: a short burst, not a steady rate. unconfirmed: no 7-day comparison, do not call it real

as_of.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the yields index read, or null when nothing was read

estimate.description: Fee-versus-impermanent-loss estimate, present only when holding_days and price_now were passed

break_even_prices.description: Later prices where the net result crosses zero, from a sample

fee_fraction.description: Expected fee income over the holding period, as a fraction of the position: 0.0153 means 1.53%

il_fraction_at_later.description: Impermanent loss at price_later as a negative fraction. null without price_later

in_range_now.description: Whether price_now is inside the range. null for the full-range formula

message.description: What happened and what to pass next

other_tiers.description: Other matching pools or fee tiers. Pass one pool_id from here to read it

fee_rate.description: Swap fee as a fraction, not a percent: 0.003 means 0.3%. Read from pool_meta

pool_meta.description: DefiLlama pool label, often the fee tier such as "0.3%"

tvl_usd.description: Total value locked in the pool, in USD

fee_apr_percent_1d.description: Fee APR in percent from 1-day volume: volume x fee_rate x 365 / TVL x 100

fee_apr_percent_7d.description: Fee APR in percent from 7-day volume, annualized the same way

volume_usd_1d.description: Trading volume over the last day, in USD

volume_usd_7d.description: Trading volume over the last 7 days, in USD

fee_rate.description: Swap fee as a fraction, not a percent: 0.003 means 0.3%. Read from pool_meta

pool_meta.description: DefiLlama pool label, often the fee tier such as "0.3%"

tvl_usd.description: Total value locked in the pool, in USD

fee_apr_percent_1d.description: Fee APR in percent from 1-day volume: volume x fee_rate x 365 / TVL x 100

fee_apr_percent_7d.description: Fee APR in percent from 7-day volume, annualized the same way

volume_usd_1d.description: Trading volume over the last day, in USD

volume_usd_7d.description: Trading volume over the last 7 days, in USD

price_trend.description: Price change per token from DefiLlama coins

change_1d_percent.description: Price change over 1 day, in percent

change_7d_percent.description: Price change over 7 days, in percent

points.description: How many price points the change uses

status.description: unsupported: no public source covers this chain

as_of.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the yields index read, or null when nothing was read

status.description: ok: one pool read (other fee tiers of the same pair are in other_tiers). ambiguous: the symbols match different tokens, see other_tiers. needs_tokens: pass token addresses or a pool id. not_found: no match. unavailable: a source did not answer

token_risk.description: GoPlus token-security flags per token, when the chain is covered

severe.description: True when a severe flag is set, such as honeypot or cannot-buy

status.description: unsupported: no public source covers this chain

top10_holder_percent.description: Share held by the 10 largest holders, in percent

top_holder_percent.description: Share held by the largest holder, in percent
